name: ClickSyncr for Kit – Contact Form 7 Integration (ConvertKit)
author: ClickSyncr

sections.description:
ClickSyncr is a Kit integration for Contact Form 7, and it supports accounts previously known as ConvertKit. It connects your forms to Kit, sending each configured submission to the Kit form you choose and mapping Contact Form 7 fields to Kit subscriber fields. Learn more about the Contact Form 7 to Kit integration.

Connect with a Kit v4 API key, choose a Kit form, and map the required email field, first name, and the custom fields you want to sync. Because Kit identifies subscribers by email address, submitting the same email again updates the existing subscriber instead of creating a duplicate.

“Kit” and “ConvertKit” are trademarks of Kit, Inc. This plugin is an independent integration and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Kit, Inc.

Kit and ConvertKit Integration for Contact Form 7

  • Connect inside Contact Form 7 — enter a Kit v4 API key in the ClickSyncr Kit tab. No developers, no code.
  • Choose a Kit form — select the destination independently for each Contact Form 7 form.
  • Map subscriber fields — map the required email field, first name, and any custom field from your Kit account.
  • Configure forms independently — use different Kit forms and field mappings for different Contact Form 7 forms.
  • Keep your existing workflow — Contact Form 7 continues to handle the form and its normal email notification.
  • Stay in control of your data — only the email address and the fields you map are sent to Kit when a configured form is submitted.

How it works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Edit any Contact Form 7 form and open the ClickSyncr Kit tab.
  3. Paste your Kit v4 API key — your Kit forms and custom fields load in the editor.
  4. Choose a Kit form and map your form fields to Kit subscriber fields (email is required).
  5. Save the form. Every submission is now synced to Kit.

What you’ll need

  • WordPress 6.7 or higher
  • Contact Form 7 installed and activated
  • A Kit account with a v4 API key (free accounts work)

Getting your Kit API key

  1. Log in to your Kit account.
  2. Open your account settings and go to the Developer (API Keys) section.
  3. Create a v4 API key.
  4. Paste it into the ClickSyncr Kit tab.

Support

Need a hand? Visit clicksyncr.com and we’ll be glad to help.

External service: Kit

This plugin connects to Kit (formerly ConvertKit), the email marketing service, to sync your Contact Form 7 submissions with your Kit account. Requests are sent to the Kit API at api.kit.com.

When data is sent: when you connect your API key, when your forms and custom fields load in the form editor, and when a visitor submits a form you’ve configured with ClickSyncr — at which point their form data (email and any mapped fields) is sent to Kit.

What is sent: your Kit API key (to authenticate), the subscriber’s email address and any fields you choose to map, and the Kit form you select.

By using this plugin you agree to Kit’s Privacy Policy. You are responsible for complying with applicable data-protection laws (such as GDPR and CCPA) and for obtaining consent from your visitors before their data is collected and sent to Kit.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “ClickSyncr for Kit”.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.

After installation

  1. Make sure Contact Form 7 is installed and activated.
  2. Edit any Contact Form 7 form and open the ClickSyncr Kit tab.
  3. Follow the on-screen setup. Full guidance is on the ClickSyncr for Kit page.
sections.faq:
How do I connect Contact Form 7 to Kit?

Edit a Contact Form 7 form, open the ClickSyncr Kit tab, enter a Kit v4 API key, choose a Kit form, and map the form’s email and subscriber fields. Save the form and submit a test entry to confirm the subscriber is created or updated.

Does this Contact Form 7 integration work with ConvertKit?

Yes. ConvertKit is now named Kit. ClickSyncr uses the current Kit v4 API and works with your existing ConvertKit or Kit account.

Can Contact Form 7 add subscribers to a Kit form?

Yes. ClickSyncr sends submissions from each configured Contact Form 7 form to the Kit form selected in that form’s settings.

Which fields can I map?

You can map the required email field, first name, and any custom field you’ve created in your Kit account — ClickSyncr loads your Kit custom fields automatically.

Do I need a Kit account?

Yes. You’ll need an active Kit account and a v4 API key. Free Kit accounts work.

Where do I find my Kit API key?

Log in to Kit, open your account settings, go to the Developer (API Keys) section, and create a v4 API key.

What happens if Kit is unreachable?

Your form still sends its normal Contact Form 7 email — ClickSyncr never blocks your forms. ClickSyncr does not queue or retry a failed sync; because Kit matches subscribers by email, the next submission from the same address updates the subscriber.

Can I use different settings for different forms?

Yes. Every Contact Form 7 form has its own ClickSyncr Kit setup, so each can sync to a different Kit form with its own field mapping.
